cards.title: Vite + Vue scaffold
cards.notes: Vite + Vue 3 base app, Patrick Hand font, structure ready for camera + OCR + annotation pipeline.

cards.title: Camera capture + fallback
cards.notes: Safari MediaDevices camera with environment-facing preference plus file upload fallback for locked-down iPads.

cards.title: Fix ‘Start Camera’ Feature
cards.feedback: Right now in our scan grade app, camera does not start when button clicked. I’ve allowed access in my iPhone and I see the green camera light come on but no preview loads.

cards.title: CSV/JSON export
cards.notes: Export graded results as CSV (for Sheets/Excel) and JSON (for programmatic use) after JPG/PDF export is working.

cards.title: ONNX digit classifier
cards.notes: Browser ONNX model (~200KB) that reads 28x28 digit crops and outputs 0–9 using ONNX Runtime Web.

cards.title: Red pen annotation layer
cards.notes: Canvas overlay that draws checkmarks, Xs, circles, and correct digits using red rgba(220,38,38,0.85).

cards.title: Worksheet SVG template
cards.notes: Printable SVG worksheet for 8.5x11 with a digit-box grid and QR in the corner, consistent layout for CV.

cards.title: QR generator pipeline
cards.notes: Generate QR codes encoding {id, version, answers[]} JSON, base64-encoded, rendered into worksheet corners.

cards.title: Blueprint + V1 roadmap
cards.notes: Master spec for ScanGrade: purpose, V1 feature set, OCR thresholds, annotation style, and export priorities.

current_mission: Ship ScanGrade MVP: one clean worksheet + scoring pipeline that works end-to-end!
